Jo Bheji Thi Duaa is a latest song from the upcoming political thriller Shanghai. The starcast includes Emraan Hashmi, Abhay Deol and Kalki Koechlin
Song: "Duaa"
Singer: Nandini Srikar, Arijit Singh, Additional Vocals: Shekhar Ravjiani
Movie: Shanghai
Starcast: Emraan Hashmi, Abhay Deol, Kalki Koechlin, Prosenjit Chatterjee
Music Director: Vishal - Shekhar
Lyricist: Kumaar
Music Label: T-Series
